</div>

<div class="project-short">
Using regression modeling and media performance analysis to optimize marketing budget allocation decisions.

<details>
<summary>Read More</summary>

<div class="project-content">

### Managerial Problem
Determine which marketing channels are driving website traffic and how media budget should be allocated more efficiently.

Exploratory analysis, correlation review, linear regression, channel comparison, and ROI-focused interpretation.

### Business Impact
Supports smarter budget allocation by identifying high-performing channels and areas of inefficient spend.
